pattern.short_summary: Instead of an open input box, the system attaches the same small, named menu of prepared prompts to every content unit it holds.
pattern.definition: Instead of an open input box, the system attaches the same small, named menu of prepared prompts to every content unit it holds. Invoking one runs its prompt against that unit. The user's expressive choice is reduced to picking which of the fixed actions to apply and to which unit.
pattern.structural_signature: The content is partitioned into units; a fixed vocabulary of n named actions is defined once, system-wide; each unit exposes all n as invocable affordances, and invocation binds (action, unit) into a generation call. The action set does not vary by unit and is not editable by the user, so the interaction space is exactly units × actions. Transplants to any repository of units — a codebase with a fixed per-function action menu, a document set with a fixed per-section menu.

dimension.category_description: How users, artifacts, examples, parameters, or user-state signals specify intent and shape the system's next behavior.
dimension.classification_boundary: Requires a user-facing specification or adaptive interaction; invisible sensing infrastructure is excluded.
